english.title: Holder of scrap metal dealers collector's licence fail to record details when disposing of scrap metal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a scrap metal dealer, having disposed of scrap metal in the course of business under a collector's licence, failed to record the

(A)_[date and time of the disposal]_
(B)_[full name and address of the person to whom it was disposed]_
(C)_[date and time of the disposal and the full name and address of the person to whom it was disposed]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 14(4) and 15(4) and (6) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 2013.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsOn the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
